Name: Climates of Ferngill
Author: Sakorona
Description:
[size=4][b]As of the upcoming* 1.6, this mod is officially dead. For a good reason: you can set weather patterns in Content Patcher now, rather than needing a full
blown C# mod.

Thank you, to everyone who downloaded this mod and enjoyed it. [/b][/size][size=6]
[/size][size=4]
* I can't really speak as to when 1.6 will be out, but I do know the upcoming SMAPI and CP improvements make this irrelevant.[/size][size=6]

Climates of Ferngill[/size]

[size=4][b]What's New[/b][/size]
- Variable Rain.
- Fog and Blizzards

[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Supports MP, with most features locked out to main player

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

- SMAPI 3.8+
- Stardew Valley 1.5+
 
[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

This mod is in a beta state due to needing to rebuild it, but here's what's working now

Note: Some features from the original mod are not yet recreated!

[b]Install Instructions
[/b]Install into your Mods/ folder. [b]Make sure any folder labeled ClimatesOfFerngill/ is uninstalled.

[/b]
[size=4][b]Acknowledgements[/b][/size]
See [url=https://github.com/Sakorona/SDVMods/tree/develop/ClimatesOfFerngill#acknowledgements]https://github.com/Sakorona/SDVMods/tree/develop/ClimatesOfFerngill#acknowledgements[/url] (Hadi deserves all of the credit for the fog textures!)


If I have left you out of acknowledgements, please contact me so I can get you added to the acknowledgement list
